claims.text: WTaTiVZr is equimolar, corresponding to approximately 20 at.% of each constituent.
The tested WTaTiVZr material is produced by powder metallurgy.
The initial WTaTiVZr microstructure is homogeneous.
The initial WTaTiVZr microstructure is single-phase BCC.
WTaTiVZr has greater high-temperature plastic strain before failure than commercially used pure tungsten.
WTaTiVZr has greater high-temperature toughness, represented by a larger area under the stress-strain curve, than pure tungsten.
The chemical complexity of WTaTiVZr produces substantial local lattice distortions.
WTaTiVZr has a refined grain structure relative to conventional pure tungsten.
Local lattice distortions in WTaTiVZr lower the energy barriers for dislocation nucleation and motion.
WTaTiVZr exhibits enhanced mobile edge-dislocation activity at high temperature.
The refined grain structure of WTaTiVZr promotes grain-boundary sliding.
Lattice distortion and refined grain boundaries produce a higher density of active dislocations in WTaTiVZr.
Active dislocations and refined grain boundaries redistribute stress more efficiently in WTaTiVZr than in pure tungsten.
Enhanced dislocation activity, grain-boundary sliding, and stress redistribution delay crack nucleation and propagation.
Pure tungsten has a high ductile-to-brittle transition temperature that restricts its plasma-facing applications.
Pure tungsten has limited dislocation activity relative to WTaTiVZr under the proposed conditions.
The proposed mechanism operates near or above 1000 °C under plasma-facing-component service conditions.
At substantially lower temperatures, the dislocation-mobility difference between WTaTiVZr and pure tungsten is less pronounced.

contradictions.description: The design permits a creep test as an alternative to a tensile test, but toughness is defined as area under a stress-strain curve and plastic strain before fracture. A conventional constant-load creep test alone does not directly provide the specified toughness measurement, so the allowed test and required outcome are not fully aligned.
